facts.business: Trans India House Impex Limited is engaged in trading and distribution activities with a subsidiary in the IDA Group.

auditor.name: Manoj Acharya & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters: (i) Creditors not classified into MSME and Non-MSME; no interest provided for delayed payments to MSMEs. (ii) Significant increase in sales in March 2026 quarter; impact not ascertainable. (iii) Trade debtor balance confirmations pending; recoverability uncertain. (iv) Outstanding income tax liability of Rs. 60.50 crore for AY 2024-25 under appeal.

key_risks: Creditors not classified into MSME and Non-MSME; potential interest liability for delayed payments
Significant sales concentration in March 2026 quarter; authenticity and impact uncertain
Pending trade debtor balance confirmations; possible provisions for doubtful debts
Outstanding income tax demand of Rs. 60.50 crore for AY 2024-25 under appeal; potential impact on profitability
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for material related party transactions with Upwise Business Consultants Private Limited (entity with common directors, shareholding and significant influence of promoters) up to Rs. 50 crore per transaction.
